density.$description: Density multiplier: 0.8 compact, 1 default, 1.2 comfortable. Multiply custom spacing by it, e.g. calc(var(--apui-space-4) * var(--apui-density)).

padding.$description: Card and panel padding. Follows data-density.

height.$description: Table row and menu item height. Follows data-density.

padding-x.$description: Table cell inline padding. Follows data-density.

gap.$description: Vertical gap between form fields. Follows data-density.
